poll.question: At dawn: Do all three cross the rope together, or do Chills and Wesley scout first while you wait in camp?

options.label: Cross all together
options.desc: One family, one crossing. Stay whole.

options.label: They scout first
options.desc: Let them test the rope. You're safe here. Trust them.

in_play.label: Cross tomorrow
in_play.desc: Trust Wesley's knots and your bond
